summary: WISeQey Corp., a British Virgin Islands foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report) disclosing that subsidiary SEALSQ Corp. issued an October 15, 2026 press release with preliminary unaudited 9M 2026 results. Revenue was $16.3 million, up 65% year-on-year from $9.9 million, aided by nine months of IC ALPS consolidation (~$3.8 million) and initial Murcia, Spain revenue. Cash, equivalents and restricted cash totaled approximately $463.0 million at September 30, 2026. Full-year guidance was reaffirmed; VaultIC408 achieved FIPS 140-3 Level 3 and the pipeline exceeds $200 million through 2029. No transaction, board recommendation or advisor was named.
